user_story: As a user, I want my password reset token to be invalidated after use so that it cannot be reused.

positive.title: Password reset using valid token
steps: Receive password reset token via email.
Use the received token to reset the password.
positive.expected_result: Password is reset successfully and the token becomes invalid.

negative.title: Reusing the same token after successful password reset
steps: Receive password reset token via email.
Use the received token to reset the password.
Attempt to use the same token again.
negative.expected_result: Password reset fails with an error indicating the token is invalid or has already been used.

edge.title: Attempt using expired but unused token
steps: Receive password reset token via email.
Wait until the token expiry time has passed.
Attempt to use the expired token to reset the password.
edge.expected_result: Password reset fails with an error indicating the token is expired.
